name: wait_then_clear_global_table
description: Spins until a status flag in the working structure clears, then zeroes a counted run of global words in groups of three and clears one word field of the structure. The count is read from a structure field.

name: expand_nibbles_into_two_buffers
description: Takes the low four bits of each of two 16-bit values in turn and stores each one in the high half of a byte, writing two bytes into each of two destination buffers.

name: copy_table_high_nibbles
description: Sets a countdown field to 15, stores a masked value in another field, calls three routines, then copies the upper four bits of three consecutive table bytes into a global buffer, repeating for a counted number of groups.

name: index_list_entries_into_table
description: Clears a 16-byte table by calling a routine for each entry, then walks a linked list of records until a terminator. For each record whose key falls in a 64-value range it marks a slot in the table, stores a running index, masks the record's second word and calls a routine.

name: tick_state_countdown_timers
description: Decrements up to four countdown fields in the working structure when their enable bits are set, updating status bits and calling a routine when a counter drops below zero. The final expiry branch holds no valid code, so it is decoder fallout rather than behaviour.

name: invert_flagged_table_bytes
description: Walks seven table entries backward, eight bytes apart, and for each entry that is zero or whose bit in the state flags is set, inverts the byte and calls a routine.

name: blit_masked_column_rows
description: Sets a status bit, then either writes one source byte to a destination or, when the second source byte is nonzero, ORs its masked upper bits into thirteen destination bytes spaced 40 apart, leaving the other bits unchanged.

name: step_speed_toward_target
description: When a status bit is set and an enable field is clear, moves a byte counter one step toward zero and nudges a word field one step toward 38 on each call.

name: accumulate_offsets_until_negative
description: Walks an array of word pairs, writing a running total into each first word and adding each second word to the total, and stops at the first pair whose second word is negative.

name: scan_records_for_terminator
description: Advances through eight-byte records until one has a negative value in its second long, doing no other work.

name: clear_block_and_stamp_tag
description: Calls a routine that returns an end address, zero-fills a block of 32-byte chunks up to that address, then writes a four-character ASCII tag into the first long of memory.

name: poll_table_entry_until_clear
description: Calls a routine, then repeatedly calls two routines while a status bit in the state block is set and the table entry indexed by the argument is not positive, and finally returns zero.

name: write_sprite_control_words
description: Derives start and end positions from two pairs of state values and, when a record pointer is set, stores the buffer address into that record and writes two packed control words in sprite-control layout.

name: save_and_install_interrupt_vectors
description: Saves the first six exception vector pairs and several custom chip register values into a buffer, points the seven autovector slots at one handler routine, clears all pending interrupt requests and zeroes a 32-long work area.

name: init_list_head_entry
description: Initialises a two-word table entry with fixed values and a terminator, stores links to the entry after it in two structure fields, and sets two control words in the structure.

name: copy_masked_flags_reset_counter
description: Copies a masked form of one state field into another field and sets a counter field to 4095. The identical bodies at neighbouring addresses do the same thing.

name: copy_masked_flags_reset_counter
description: Copies a masked form of one state field into another field and sets a counter field to 4095. The identical bodies at neighbouring addresses do the same thing.

name: copy_masked_flags_reset_counter
description: Copies a masked form of one state field into another field and sets a counter field to 4095. The identical bodies at neighbouring addresses do the same thing.

name: repeat_call_until_zero
description: Calls a routine repeatedly until it returns zero, so it blocks until the routine reports completion.

name: acquire_busy_flag_spinlock
description: Spins, setting the top bit of a state byte, until a read shows that bit was previously clear, which acquires a simple lock.

name: acquire_low_bit_spinlock
description: Spins, setting the status bit with value 8 in a state byte, until a read shows that bit was previously clear, which acquires a lock.

name: read_masked_status_flags
description: Returns the bits of a state byte selected by a fixed mask, so callers can test two status flags together.

name: repeat_call_until_zero_flag
description: Calls a routine repeatedly while the zero condition left by the preceding test stays clear, so it waits on that routine's result.

name: wait_until_status_bit_clear
description: Spins while the status bit with value 2 in a state byte stays set, returning once it clears.

name: find_region_record_at_position
description: Scans an eight-word record table for the entry whose x and y ranges contain the current position, storing its index. It returns the x offset from the record start, zero when the record links to another structure, or -1 when no record matches.

name: copy_flag_group_arm_counter
description: Copies one group of state flag bits into another field and, if any of those bits are set, sets a counter field to 4095.

name: poll_fire_button_port
description: Copies a masked state flag, then if a button-port bit is set it waits briefly, clears a control bit and stores a 0 or -1 value in a table entry from a second port byte. It calls a routine when that entry is set and in range.

name: forward_stack_value_to_routine
description: Calls a routine and passes through the value it was given on the stack, so it acts as a transparent wrapper.

name: translate_key_code_to_cell
description: Stores a translated key code and its table entry in the state, then when a mode flag is set it finds the code in an eight-character list. It uses the matching value to search the position table for a grid cell, storing the index and returning a cell offset or an error value.

name: append_char_to_ring_buffer
description: Stores the character passed in at the current index of a 32-byte ring buffer, replacing a carriage return with an asterisk and setting a flag. It then advances the index with wraparound.

name: copy_message_text_with_escapes
description: Writes a leading marker byte, then copies a null-terminated message into a text buffer. Control and high-bit characters go to a called routine for expansion, other characters are copied directly, and an asterisk terminates the result.

name: format_number_into_text
description: Converts a value through a called routine and writes its digits with leading zeros dropped, adding a minus sign when the flag byte says so. Values outside that range are copied from a prepared string, and the text always ends with a space.

name: copy_text_until_asterisk_spaced
description: Calls a routine to prepare a source string, then copies it character by character until an asterisk, and ends the output with a space.

name: copy_text_counted_with_terminator
description: Copies up to a counted number of characters from a source string, stopping early at an asterisk, and writes an asterisk after the copied text.

name: skip_to_text_entry
description: Looks up an offset for a five-bit index in a table, then skips over the count plus one asterisk-terminated strings from that position.

name: clear_pointer_and_sum_offsets
description: Calls a routine, clears a pointer field if it is set, then calls a routine again and stores the sum of two state words into a field.

name: draw_text_string_glyphs
description: Interprets a text string with embedded control codes and draws each character as eight shifted rows into a bitplane. Each row is merged with a mask or inverted according to a mode bit, and the routine stops at the terminator and returns the updated position.

name: clear_rows_of_bytes
description: Calls a routine for the starting address, then zeroes a block of bytes whose row count is a state field plus the routine's result, using the width and row stride passed in.

name: stub_no_operation_return
description: Contains only a return, so calling it has no effect. It serves as a callback with no body.

name: pass_through_routine_result
description: Calls a routine and returns whatever registers it left, so it forwards that result unchanged.

name: sum_table_weights_until_byte
description: Walks a byte string until it reaches the terminator value, adding each character's table weight plus one to a running total, and returns that total.

name: format_signed_word_five_digits
description: Writes the five decimal digits of the absolute value of a signed word as ASCII into a fixed five-byte text buffer, then returns a state word.

name: write_signed_five_digits_short
description: Writes the five decimal digits of the absolute value of a signed word as ASCII into a fixed five-byte text buffer.

name: write_signed_five_digits_long
description: Writes the five decimal digits of the absolute value of a 32-bit signed value as ASCII into a fixed five-byte text buffer.

name: write_signed_five_digits_word
description: Writes the five decimal digits of the absolute value of a signed word as ASCII into a fixed five-byte text buffer, using the same logic as its neighbours.

name: weighted_digit_string_value
description: Sets a status bit in a state word, then converts a string of decimal digit characters into a number by multiplying each digit by a weight from a table and summing the results.

name: handle_control_state_bits
description: Copies masked control bits into a state field, then depending on which bits are set it calls a routine, decrements one or two counters and clears status bits. It calls a routine through a stored pointer when the top control bit is set.

name: dispatch_pending_state_handler
description: Checks two status flags and calls the routine at a dispatch-table offset for the first flag that is set, returning its result, or returns -1 when neither flag is set.

name: advance_timed_sequence_counters
description: Runs a routine, then while a status bit is set it advances a counter and calls routines when the counter reaches its condition. It also calls routines for two other status bits and returns the final result word.

name: read_joystick_position_deltas
description: Reads the joystick port counters and button input, computes the change since the last read, and moves the position fields toward their limits by that change. It stores a direction nibble for later use.

name: step_run_length_list_entry
description: Steps through a run-length list of byte pairs, calling routines for entries with the sign bit set until it reaches an entry without it. It then stores that entry's bits and waits through a short delay loop.

name: busy_delay_countdown_loop
description: Decrements a 16-bit count from its starting value until it wraps past zero, producing a short delay.

name: clear_status_bit_two
description: Clears the status bit with value 2 in a state byte and returns.

name: prepare_next_position_record
description: Writes a 32-bit pair into four-byte-spaced bytes, copies table values into state fields, and if the table entry is valid it waits on a status bit. It then copies position and velocity words into a record and advances the position state for the next step.

name: copy_position_record_and_step
description: Decrements a counter byte and clears a callback pointer when it reaches zero, copies the current position and step words into a record, and advances the position state by the step value.

name: clip_bounds_and_setup_blit
description: Checks that a point lies inside the bounds held in state and, if so, records the bit offset and row stride, clips the row count against the bounds and sets up blit addresses, returning zero. Points outside the bounds return -1.

name: clip_rows_and_setup_blit
description: Records the bit offset and row stride, clips the row count against a state bound, and calls a routine to set up addresses. It returns zero when at least one row remains, otherwise -1.

name: encode_nibble_into_blit_masks
description: Derives a shift-based mask from the low four bits of its argument, stores it with the shifted value into state fields, and returns the signed upper bits doubled as a column offset.

name: store_word_return_column_offset
description: Stores a value passed in another register into a state field and returns the upper four bits of its argument, doubled, as a column offset.

name: init_record_under_lock
description: Spins until the status bit with value 2 in a state byte was previously clear, then clears a callback pointer and initialises several record fields, including setting one to 426 and copying another from state.

name: init_record_and_wait_status
description: Spins until the status bit with value 2 in a state byte was previously clear, initialises record fields including one set to 938, then spins until that bit clears again.

name: zero_word_block_with_tail
description: Zeroes a block of 16-bit words whose count is half the length argument, then clears one extra byte when the length is odd.

name: repeat_four_calls_while_flag
description: Calls four routines in sequence on each pass and repeats while the flag saved from the previous pass remains set.

name: set_tag_clear_status_bit
description: Sets a status bit, writes a fixed four-character tag into a global location, calls two routines, then clears another status bit and returns zero.

name: compare_long_arrays_equal
description: Compares two arrays of longs element by element for a counted length, returning -1 at the first mismatch and zero when every element matches.

name: select_table_entry_for_index
description: Stores a pointer and an index in the state, copies a scaled value and a byte from a 32-byte-per-entry table into fields, and returns a word from that entry.

name: process_fourteen_record_slots
description: Writes a fixed four-character tag at the start, then for up to fourteen records it clears a status bit and, when that bit was set, calls a routine with a stored byte and marks the record active. The record address advances by a fixed stride until it passes a limit.

name: poll_status_table_until_idle
description: Calls a routine, then loops calling two routines while the status flag stays set and the table entry indexed by the argument is non-positive, and returns zero.

name: poll_status_table_until_idle
description: Calls a routine, then loops calling two routines while the status flag stays set and the table entry indexed by the argument is non-positive, and returns zero.

name: map_state_nibble_offset
description: Returns -1 when the negative condition is set. Otherwise it takes the low nibble of a state byte and returns that nibble minus two unless it is 1 or 2, and the 1 or 2 case ends in invalid decoded code.

name: copy_indexed_table_block
description: Sets a flag, then either copies a table-selected block of longs into the destination for a counted length, or, when a second flag is clear, computes a clipped segment and calls a routine with its parameters.

name: run_keyboard_scan_sequence
description: Stores its arguments and a mode bit in the state, then either strobes the keyboard matrix lines or runs a loop that calls a routine and counts events until the count runs out. A closing sweep writes a countdown from 4095 to zero into a second field.

name: strobe_keyboard_matrix_lines
description: Writes six fixed patterns in turn to a byte-wide port, strobing the keyboard matrix lines.

name: call_three_routines_in_order
description: Calls three routines in sequence and returns, with no other work.

name: wait_port_bit_clear_bounded
description: Polls the status bit with value 32 in a port byte for up to 16384 iterations and returns as soon as that bit clears.

name: select_port_b_mask
description: Chooses one of two bit masks from a flag byte, stores it in a state field, and writes its complement limited to seven bits to a port register.

name: step_wrapping_counter_toggle_bit
description: Decrements a counter by two, wrapping back to 18 when it goes negative, toggles one bit in a state word, and calls two routines.

name: call_or_idle_forever
description: Calls a routine, then either enters an endless loop calling another routine when the zero condition is set, or calls a routine and repeats while that condition holds.

name: wait_port_bit_clear_word
description: Calls a routine repeatedly while the status bit with value 16 in a port byte stays set, then zeroes a state word.

name: step_counter_toward_target
description: Calls a routine if a counter is negative, then steps a counter toward a target by the difference between two state values, calling routines once per step.

name: repeat_two_calls_counted
description: Calls a routine once, then calls two routines in a loop that runs once per count in a register, plus one.

name: busy_delay_fixed_count
description: Counts a 16-bit register down from a fixed value until it wraps past zero, giving a fixed short delay.

name: write_byte_pair_to_register
description: Writes two byte values in turn to the address held in a pointer register, so the second value is the one left behind.

name: stub_empty_decoded_body
description: The decoded body is empty, so calling it does nothing.

name: init_disk_sync_state
description: Stores its argument and several fixed words into a state block, including the standard disk sync word, and saves two callback pointers and a long value from a global.

name: start_disk_dma_transfer
description: Points the disk DMA pointer at a stored address, sets the sync word and MFM-related control bits, clears the block-done request and starts a transfer with the length taken from state.

name: wait_disk_block_done
description: Polls for up to 16384 iterations for the disk block-done request bit and then clears the disk length register.

name: spin_forever_no_exit
description: Loops forever without doing any work, so control never returns from it.

name: run_disk_dma_and_wait
description: Starts a disk DMA transfer with a length from a routine, waits for the block-done bit, then stops DMA by clearing the length register.

name: copy_sector_blocks_from_table
description: Copies up to ten 512-byte blocks from a pointer table into the destination buffer, stopping early when the output reaches the end address in state. It returns -1 when the preceding check fails.

name: decode_mfm_sectors_by_sync
description: Scans for disk sync words and decodes up to eleven MFM sectors by recombining odd and even bit halves, accumulating a checksum and storing each decoded buffer pointer in a table. It stops at a sector number above ten or at a nonzero checksum.

name: decode_mfm_sectors_register_mask
description: Decodes MFM sectors in a loop using a mask register for the odd and even bit halves, storing each decoded buffer pointer in a table. It stops at a sector number above ten, a nonzero checksum, or when the sector count runs out.

name: merge_odd_even_bits
description: Combines two longwords by masking one with a bit pattern held in a register and shifting the other left by one bit, recombining the odd and even bit halves of an MFM-encoded value.

name: return_stack_value_unchanged
description: Returns the value passed on the stack without changing it.

name: stub_empty_return_only
description: Contains only a return, so it does nothing. It looks like unreached padding decoded as code.

name: store_combined_state_byte
description: Adds a byte field to twice a word field from state, stores the result in a global byte, then calls a routine.

name: encode_mfm_track_gap_sync
description: Fills a track buffer with an alternating gap pattern, then writes sync marks and encoded sector data for each sector in a loop, calling routines to encode each one.

name: clear_mfm_clock_bit
description: Clears the top bit of a byte when the preceding byte has its low bit set.

name: clear_clock_bits_in_pairs
description: Walks pairs of longwords for a counted length, clearing the top bit of each value whose preceding byte has its low bit set, and writes both values back.

name: call_two_routines_in_order
description: Calls two routines in sequence and returns.

name: stub_empty_return_slot
description: Contains only a return and performs no work. It is an entry reached through an address table.

name: build_crc16_lookup_table
description: Builds a 256-entry CRC-16 lookup table using the CCITT polynomial 4129, storing the high and low bytes of each entry in two parallel byte tables.
